card.name: Start of split medical words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer medical word that is split up, such as st before riae or inging, cor before neal, or St before argardt. It appears after a comma or an opening bracket in lists of skin reactions or conditions.

modes.label: Skin reaction terms
modes.description: The first piece of a skin side effect word in a list after a comma.
